Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
// Sorting
document.querySelectorAll('#dg-table th[data-sort]').forEach(function (th) {
  th.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var tbody = document.getElementById('dg-body');
    var rows = Array.from(tbody.rows);
    var idx = Array.from(th.parentNode.children).indexOf(th);
    var dir = th.dataset.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    th.dataset.dir = dir;
    rows.sort(function (a, b) {
      var av = a.children[idx].textContent.trim();
      var bv = b.children[idx].textContent.trim();
      return dir === 'asc' ? av.localeCompare(bv) : bv.localeCompare(av);
    });
    rows.forEach(function (r) { tbody.appendChild(r); });
  });
});

// Select all / row selection
document.getElementById('dg-select-all').addEventListener('change', function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dg-row-check').forEach(function (cb) {
    cb.checked = document.getElementById('dg-select-all').checked;
    cb.closest('tr').classList.toggle('zak-row-selected', cb.checked);
  });
  updateSelectedCount();
});
document.querySelectorAll('.dg-row-check').forEach(function (cb) {
  cb.addEventListener('change', function () {
    cb.closest('tr').classList.toggle('zak-row-selected', cb.checked);
    updateSelectedCount();
  });
});
function updateSelectedCount() {
  document.getElementById('dg-selected-count').textContent = document.querySelectorAll('.dg-row-check:checked').length;
}

// Search filter
document.getElementById('dg-search').addEventListener('input', function () {
  var q = this.value.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll('#dg-body tr').forEach(function (row) {
    row.style.display = row.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ? '' : 'none';
  });
});

// Compact toggle
function toggleCompact() {
  document.getElementById('dg-table').classList.toggle('zak-datagrid-compact');
}
